functions.recoveredRole: Reset the Analysis Parameters dialog working state to TINA built-in defaults
functions.behavior: Copies the complete 50-slot built-in analysis-settings record and its description into the dialog working state, clears the dynamic AttributeGrid content, and rebuilds the parameter editors. It does not request confirmation, change active settings, or write a parameter file; callers commit the working record only after mrOk.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds PMIDefault.OnClick and gives it the caption Tina default. FUN_01153470 copies 0x32 qwords from PTR_DAT_02001120 + 200 to form offset +0x740, assigns the string at default offset +600 to form offset +0x8d8, clears the AttributeGrid through FUN_00b0b020(grid, 0), and calls FUN_01152760. The rebuild reads 45 values from +0x740, creates typed grid editors, and assigns +0x8d8 to memoComment. Callers FUN_01c76bb0 and FUN_01532880 copy the dialog record to PTR_DAT_02004010 only when ShowModal returns 1.
